stem: A client with elevated blood pressure asks which lifestyle changes can help prevent progression to hypertension. Which teaching is most consistent with the current guideline?

options.A: Avoid physical activity until blood pressure returns to normal.
options.B: Follow a heart-healthy pattern such as DASH, reduce sodium, stay physically active, and work toward a healthy weight.
options.C: Lifestyle changes have little role unless antihypertensive medication has already been started.
options.D: Increase sodium intake when exercising so dietary changes do not affect blood pressure.

rationale: The 2025 ACC/AHA high blood pressure guideline strongly recommends lifestyle changes for prevention and treatment of elevated blood pressure and hypertension, including a heart-healthy eating pattern such as DASH, reduced sodium intake, regular physical activity, and maintaining or achieving a healthy weight. B directly reflects this guidance. A and C contradict the guideline's emphasis on lifestyle intervention, while D reverses the sodium recommendation.
educational_objective: Teach clients with elevated blood pressure that DASH-style eating, sodium reduction, regular physical activity, and healthy weight management are evidence-based measures to prevent or treat hypertension.
source_organization: American Heart Association (AHA) and American College of Cardiology (ACC)
source_document_title: 2025 Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults
source_locator: Top Things to Know, item 5: lifestyle changes are strongly recommended for all adults to prevent or treat elevated blood pressure/hypertension, including healthy weight, heart-healthy eating such as DASH, sodium reduction, moderate physical activity, stress management, and reducing/eliminating alcohol.
source_claim_supported: Current hypertension guidance supports DASH-style eating, lower sodium intake, physical activity, and weight management as core lifestyle measures for elevated blood pressure and hypertension.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Health Promotion and Maintenance: provide education about health promotion and disease prevention and reinforce modifiable lifestyle risk-factor interventions.
blueprint_topic: Health Promotion and Maintenance — hypertension prevention through lifestyle modification
correction_summary: Updated the source from a generic AHA page to the current 2025 ACC/AHA hypertension guideline and replaced filler distractors with realistic lifestyle misconceptions.
audit_findings: Currentness verified: the 2025 guideline replaced the 2017 ACC/AHA guideline. B matches the guideline; A/C/D contradict explicit recommendations. No unnecessary numeric sodium, exercise, BP or weight target is tested. Blueprint directly fits prevention teaching. Independent adversarial second pass found no second answer, cueing, ambiguity or unresolved conflict.
